Package dev.px.core.config

Class ConfigService

java.lang.Object
dev.px.core.config.ConfigService
All Implemented Interfaces:
Named, Service
public final class ConfigService extends Object implements Service
Saves and loads named config profiles.

One JSON file per profile, holding every registered ConfigSection. The old scheme wrote five text files per profile in a directory and parsed them by splitting on colons, which is why loadModules carried the comment about not working; a module whose name contained a colon, or a value that failed to parse, corrupted the rest of the line silently.

Sections are loaded independently and a failure in one is logged and skipped, so a partially unreadable config still restores everything else.
